subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Should the remaining Feishu restart bug be solved with a Feishu-owned reconnect drain, a core startup readiness gate, or a retry-count reset policy?
rationale: All three approaches can change user-visible delivery semantics; source evidence favors an existing channel-owned drain, but the exact Feishu readiness signal and retry reset policy need maintainer intent before automation edits the path.

options.title: Feishu reconnect drain
options.body: Add a Feishu-owned drainPendingDeliveries call when the WebSocket transport becomes ready and prove it with live restart evidence.

options.title: Core readiness gate
options.body: Delay generic startup recovery until all configured channel transports report ready, accepting broader startup coupling and potential cross-channel impact.

options.title: Retry reset policy
options.body: Reset or cap retryCount across restart boundaries, but only after maintainers explicitly accept the risk of masking real repeated delivery failures.

recommendation.title: Feishu reconnect drain
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-owned drainPendingDeliveries call when the WebSocket transport becomes ready and prove it with live restart evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses core outbound recovery and channel/plugin ownership, and this owner has the clearest history across both boundaries.
